paragraphs.text: Gulmany , is the northernmost island of the Terisian Isles on Dominaria . It is surrounded by the Endless Sea in the north, the Sea of Laments in the east, the Sea of Almaaz in the south, and the Ilesemare Sea in the west.
The island was formed after the Ice Age from the part of Terisiare that contained the Colekgan Mountains . These are now called the Ohran Mountains , named after the Ohran Ridge .
Baszerat - a rival nation of Morvern

Efuan Pincar - the most remote nation of the Terisian Isles Avulan - a village Gam - a village of shepherds Medran - a market town Pincar City - capital of the small nation Stezine - a village south of Medran
Evean - on the eastern coast, home of the infamously viceful man Samisar .
Kovria - a large stretch of barrens, scrub, badlands and wastes. The ruins of Terisia City are rumored to be found somewhere in Kovria.

Morvern - a small nation on the southwestern part of the island. Morvern has a long-standing rivalry with the nearby country of Baszerat . During the Thaw in 3245 AR , Phyrexian sleeper agents infiltrated Morvern and inflamed relations, causing the two countries to wage war against one another - the Morvernish against the Baszerati.
Narjabul - a city on the east coast that celebrates mid-summer with a festival.

The Ohran Mountains - the central mountain range Binyen - a ruin in the mountains Karjzia - an ancient place, famous among Argivian archeologists for its gemstone mosaics The Ohran Ridge - the southwestern spur of the mountains
Russiore - a seacoast principality on the eastern coast, not far from Efuan Pincar .
Trilinga - an ancient place, famous among Argivian archeologists for the gold-embossed, hand-painted funerary portraits in its vaults
